title: loadng.c: Prune interval off-by-one
description: Line 424: The condition `atomic_dec(&prune_countdown) <= 1` triggers pruning when countdown reaches 1 (after 15 calls) rather than 0 (after 16 calls). With PRUNE_INTERVAL=16, the actual interval is 15. The condition should be `<= 0` or `== 0` to match the defined interval constant.
